title: Versioned first-touch methodology comparison v2
description: Each event payload is keyed by variant, condition_policy, event_id. Raw trades and NBBO remain source-linked local evidence.

x-scope.observed_sessions: (previous RTH close, prior 20:00 ET), [04:00 ET, current RTH close]; PRE ends at 09:30 exclusive; RTH includes open and close
x-scope.prefix_first: AH-only proof before overnight interval; incomplete tails never certify complete opportunities
x-scope.strict_full_cycle: Requires all relevant intervals including overnight; denominator is zero in this pilot
x-scope.outcome_primary_gap_policy: No mechanical trade-gap censoring; missing pages, overnight, unknown evidence, invalidation and 60-second stale marks still censor
x-scope.cohort_overlap: Memberships overlap; never sum cohort event counts as independent events
